messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Arjun Pillai
Bengaluru | arjun.embedded@example.com

SUMMARY
Embedded software engineer working on automotive ECUs and real-time firmware.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
C, C++17, Embedded C, FreeRTOS, AUTOSAR, CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, ARM Cortex-M, MISRA C, Python, Git

EXPERIENCE
Embedded Software Engineer, Bosch (2020 - Present)
Developed AUTOSAR basic software modules for a brake control ECU.
Implemented a CAN bootloader that supports secure over-the-air firmware updates.
Brought the codebase to MISRA C compliance with static analysis in Polyspace.
Debugged timing issues with an oscilloscope and a Lauterbach TRACE32 debugger.

Firmware Intern, Ather Energy (2019)
Wrote a battery management system driver for cell voltage monitoring over SPI.

EDUCATION
M.Tech Embedded Systems, VIT Vellore, 2020
B.E. Electronics, PES University, 2018

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
